label: human
comment: Any member of Homo sapiens, a unique species of hominid primates.

label: organization
comment: Social entity with a collective goal, such as institutions, companies, agencies.

label: business
comment: Organization that provides goods or services for economic activity.

label: city
comment: Large and permanent human settlement.

label: country
comment: Distinct territorial body or political entity.

label: event
comment: Occurrence at a particular time and place.

label: document
comment: Bounded physical representation of body of information designed for communication.

label: software
comment: Set of instructions that directs a computer to perform specific tasks.

label: product
comment: Object or system made available for consumer use.

label: vehicle
comment: Mobile machine used for transporting people or cargo.

label: building
comment: Structure with walls and a roof.

label: river
comment: Natural watercourse flowing towards an ocean, lake, or another river.

label: mountain
comment: Large landform that rises above surrounding terrain.

label: book
comment: Medium for recording information in the form of writing or images.

label: film
comment: Sequence of visual images shown on a screen, creating an illusion of motion.

label: musical work
comment: Distinct intellectual or artistic musical creation.

label: award
comment: Honor bestowed as a mark of recognition.

label: occupation
comment: Label applied to a person based on their vocation or role.

label: academic institution
comment: Educational institution dedicated to higher education and research.

label: government agency
comment: Permanent or semi-permanent organization in the machinery of government.

label: nonprofit organization
comment: Organization that uses surplus revenues to achieve its goals rather than distributing them.

label: sports team
comment: Group of individuals who compete together in a sport.

label: political party
comment: Political organization that runs election campaigns and seeks political power.

label: protein
comment: Biological molecule consisting of chains of amino acid residues.

label: chemical compound
comment: Pure chemical substance consisting of two or more different elements.
